svg.title: Averages from many studies pile up around the true incubation period
svg.desc: Top: incubation periods are right-skewed, with a true average of 5.5 days. Bottom: averages from 80 studies of 40 cases each stack into a narrow bell shape centered at 5.5 days. Most land in the 95% range of about 4.6 to 6.4 days; 3 studies land outside it, shown in red.
svg.text: each dot is one study's average
Same scale: averages vary far less than cases
